cards.title: Terminal Slope (Lambda Z) Estimation and Diagnostics
cards.claim: Lambda Z is estimated via linear regression of log concentration (Y) vs. time (X) (or log excretion rate vs. midpoint for urine); lambda_z is the negative fitted slope. Diagnostics include Rsq (goodness of fit), Corr_XY (correlation), and Span (ratio of Lambda Z window to half-life). Parameters like AUCINF and Vz are calculated using either the last observed (obs) or last predicted (pred) concentration/rate.
limitations: If Lambda Z cannot be estimated, No_points_lambda_z is set to zero and extrapolated parameters are not computed.
Span and Rsq are critical for assessing the validity of the terminal slope.
cards.downstream_use: Assessment of NCA model fit quality; determination of whether extrapolated parameters (AUCINF) are reliable.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
